segments.t: After hearing the whole story, Nagiyev declares that while actors can eat anything for big money, he ate it for free—so Katya, Senya, Fedya, and Barinov will all work a month without pay.
Можем съесть всё что угодно, но за большие деньги.
Значит, ты, ты и ты в этом месяце работаете бесплатно.
Ты что хотел сказать? Нагиев оказал медвежью услугу.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'We are actors.' Realizing that they are actors changes how Nagiyev handles the situation.
Можем съесть всё что угодно, но за большие деньги.
'We can eat anything at all, but for big money.' Noting that they can eat anything at all but for big money keeps Nagiyev's side of the story simple and clear.
'For big money!' With the money and shift at stake, Nagiyev reacts without holding back. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'I ate this for free today.' Admitting that he ate this for free today shows Nagiyev being honest for a change.
Значит, ты, ты и ты в этом месяце работаете бесплатно.

'So you, you, and you are working for free this month.' Saying that Barinov Barinov and Barinov is working for free this month is how Nagiyev sets the tone with Barinov. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'Understood.' Over the point and the money, Barinov answers Lyova without a second thought.
'I almost forgot. You too.' Adding that he almost forgot fills in the missing piece for Barinov.
'Can you imagine, they have three sous-chefs.' Lyova tells Barinov that can Barinov imagines they have three chefs without dressing it up.
'Around a thousand people.' With the restaurant and interview in play, Lyova keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Ты что хотел сказать? Нагиев оказал медвежью услугу.
'What did you want to say? Nagiyev did us a disservice.' By asking what Lyova wants to say, Barinov presses Lyova for a straight answer.
'Chef! Phone for you!' With the kitchen and interview at stake, Lyova reacts without holding back. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
'Excuse me. Well go on, go.' Telling Lyova to go on go moves the conversation forward without extra drama. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Можем съесть всё что угодно, но за большие деньги.
Значит, ты, ты и ты в этом месяце работаете бесплатно.
Ты что хотел сказать? Нагиев оказал медвежью услугу.
And that finishes Scene Thirteen. Listen for Nagiyev's punchline adding Barinov himself to the list of people working for free this month. Until next time!
